running_thesis: The Nasdaq-100 closed 17 Nov at 27001.78 (-0.72%) after -2.67% on 16 Nov. Cboe says the S&P 500 fell 1.0% on 17 Nov. VIX 25.46, VXN 34.44, COR1M 20.13. Nvidia beat and guided Q4 revenue to $130 billion vs $125.3 billion (Cboe), lifting AI names after hours. Headlines say futures are up (unverified). December hike: Cboe cites 97.4% on FedWatch, Polymarket 92.5% with 50+ bps at 5.0%. Yields eased (10-year 5.1%). Next: FOMC minutes (Wed 20:00 CET) and the Anthropic IPO pricing and Thursday debut. HY OAS 3.34 as of 16 Nov. Oil data are stale.

Do the FOMC minutes raise 50+ bps hike odds?

Does the Anthropic IPO support or drain AI risk appetite?
